description: This Java source file defines the ModuleCache class responsible for caching and managing module information in the Android development environment. It includes methods for initializing, retrieving, and storing module data, as well as handling external module references.

classes.name: ModuleCache
classes.description: A singleton class that caches built modules, providing methods to initialize, retrieve, and add modules based on directory or name.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ModuleCache.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the cache with module indexes from a specified file.

methods.name: getAndCacheByDir
methods.description: Retrieves a module by its directory, building and caching it if not already cached.

methods.name: getAndCacheByName
methods.description: Retrieves a module by its name, using index data to locate its makefile, then obtaining the module by directory.

methods.name: putModule
methods.description: Stores a module in the cache associated with its directory.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Retrieves a cached module based on its directory.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Returns an iterable collection of all cached modules.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a module to the cache.

search-terms: module indexing and retrieval in IDE
